issue.title: Regression: CACL tests reject protected FRR loopback iptables rules

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Previous Working Version

sonic-buildimage master before sonic-buildimage#28061, with `sonic-host-services` pinned to `233cd591c324d4090a077f87da0eaaad7d12cabc`.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Build or install a master image containing sonic-buildimage#28061 and sonic-host-services#389.
2. Run:
   `cacl/test_cacl_application.py::test_cacl_application_nondualtor[vlab-01-None]`
3. Observe that the generated expected iptables rule set does not contain the new FRR loopback protection rules.
4. The exact-set comparison reports those rules as unexpected.

This also affects `test_multiasic_cacl_application`.

sonic-mgmt#26554 temporarily skipped these tests while sonic-buildimage#28061 was open. The skip self-expired after #28061 merged, but the expected-rule generator was not updated.

### Impact of this regression

Post-sonic-buildimage#28061 master images fail the CACL application tests across affected PR-checker topologies, blocking unrelated sonic-buildimage pull requests. The DUT behavior is expected; the regression is in the sonic-mgmt expected iptables rule set.

The fix should update `generate_expected_rules()` in `tests/cacl/test_cacl_application.py` to expect the four IPv4 `OUTPUT` rules for FRR UID 300 and ports 2601 and 2620. Exact-set validation should remain enabled so missing, partial, or malformed FRR rules are still detected.

### Relevant log output

```text
Failed: iptables rules did not match either the legacy (pre multi-asic FORWARD-chain security patch) or the newer (post-patch) expected rule set.
Legacy variant - missing: set(), unexpected: {
  '-A OUTPUT -o lo -p tcp -m tcp --dport 2601 -m owner --uid-owner 300 -j ACCEPT',
  '-A OUTPUT -o lo -p tcp -m tcp --dport 2601 -j DROP',
  '-A OUTPUT -o lo -p tcp -m tcp --dport 2620 -m owner --uid-owner 300 -j ACCEPT',
  '-A OUTPUT -o lo -p tcp -m tcp --dport 2620 -j DROP'
}
FORWARD-chain variant - missing: set(), unexpected: {same four rules}
```

Example failing build: https://dev.azure.com/mssonic/build/_build/results?buildId=1187249

### References

- sonic-mgmt#26554
- sonic-buildimage#28061
- sonic-host-services#389

resolution.title: tests/cacl: add FRR loopback ACL expected rules; remove xfail marks (sonic-host-services#389)
resolution.description:
## Description

Port test coverage from internal sonic-mgmt-int now that https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-host-services/pull/389 is merged to public master.

Fixes #26908

### What changed

**`tests/cacl/test_cacl_application.py`:**

Add expected OUTPUT chain rules for FRR VTY/FPM loopback ports in `generate_expected_rules()`.
`caclmgrd` now programs these in **every managed namespace** (host and all per-ASIC namespaces on multi-ASIC) — so the rules are expected unconditionally, regardless of `asic_index`:
- Port 2620 (fpmsyncd ↔ zebra): ACCEPT for uid-owner 300 (frr user), DROP for all others
- Port 2601 (zebra VTY): ACCEPT for uid-owner 300, DROP for all others

**`tests/common/plugins/conditional_mark/tests_mark_conditions.yaml`:**

Remove the `xfail` blocks for `test_cacl_application_nondualtor` and `test_multiasic_cacl_application` that were added in #26909 as a temporary workaround pending this fix.

## Test plan

- [ ] `test_cacl_application_nondualtor` — verifies FRR OUTPUT rules appear in actual iptables (was xfail, now expected to pass)
- [ ] `test_multiasic_cacl_application` — verifies FRR OUTPUT rules appear in every ASIC namespace (was xfail, now expected to pass)

## Related

- Tracking issue: #26908
- Temporary xfail workaround: #26909
- sonic-host-services image change: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-host-services/pull/389
